rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with the provided 3BC grade: loosely grouped ICM, sparse/uneven TE, and thinned zona. It appropriately notes uncertainty in exact expansion from a single image, though some comments about collapse/handling are speculative.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male-factor diagnosis, prior cycle history, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo morphology to contextualize prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: TE C lowers prognosis, young age improves it, and 7 mm lining modestly tempers expectations. Minor overreach in discussing fresh-cycle hormonal environment without supporting lab values.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including SET in a 26-year-old and caution about overinterpreting one failed transfer. Slightly speculative on adjunct evaluations and fresh-vs-frozen implications without stronger indications.
Provides clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, SET, endometrial/hormonal review, counseling, and sensible future-cycle planning with alternatives if transfer fails.
